$meta.name: Jazlah design tokens
$meta.source: Brand + app prototype shown to and approved by the client (burgundy & gold, Turki-like premium butcher feel). See docs/design/README.md.
$meta.note: Colors and fonts are approved. The logo/wordmark must be redrawn for the name Jazlah (DSN-DES-1). Money/RTL rules: see docs/architecture.md.

brand.use: primary surfaces, app bar, primary buttons on light

gold.use: accent, highlights, price emphasis on dark, icons on brand

gold-text.use: gold used as text/icon on light backgrounds (AA 4.77 on bg, 5.24 on paper; the logo gradient mid-tone)

gold-deco.use: previous gold-text: large text (>=18px) and decoration only, 3.0-3.3 on cream

gold-light.use: gold on dark backgrounds, chips on brand

gold-gradient.use: logo / emblem only, never body UI

muted.use: hints, captions, placeholder text (AA 4.5+ on bg and paper)

muted-soft.use: previous muted: disabled text, large text and decoration only (3.8-4.2)

danger.use: errors, destructive actions, failed states (AA 5.78 on bg). Never the CTA: that is ember

danger-bg.use: error banners, field error background (danger text on it 5.58)

display.use: headings, hero titles, prices on hero
